scope: Every harness must execute with all default safety, overflow, unwinding, undefined-function, and assertion reachability checks. Pricing rate and container partitions are explicit. A timeout or missing/unsatisfied cover is a failure.
functionCoverage: Every pub fn in crates/aicharts-metrics (excluding proofs.rs and tests.rs) must be named by at least one harness's functions list or by a theorem replacement's productionFunction; scripts/assurance-kani.test.ts enforces this from the crate source.

harnesses.name: proofs::checked_add_full_u128_matches_129_bit_math
harnesses.scalarDomain: Two arbitrary u128 values; independent 129-bit limb oracle.
harnesses.containerDomain: None
requiredCoverDescriptions: cover condition: left == u128::MAX && right == 0 && actual == Ok(u128::MAX)

harnesses.name: proofs::bounded_add_full_u128_preserves_math_and_limit
harnesses.scalarDomain: Two arbitrary u128 operands and arbitrary u128 admission limit.
harnesses.containerDomain: None

harnesses.name: proofs::decimal_admission_has_exact_profile_boundary
harnesses.scalarDomain: One arbitrary u128 value; fixed production 24-digit maximum.
harnesses.containerDomain: None
requiredCoverDescriptions: cover condition: value == MAX_DECIMAL && admit_decimal(value) == Ok(value)
cover condition: value == MAX_DECIMAL + 1 && admit_decimal(value) == Err(Error::Limit)

harnesses.name: proofs::replacement_full_u128_refuses_underflow_or_overflow
harnesses.scalarDomain: Three arbitrary u128 values; previous-contribution membership is a caller obligation.
harnesses.containerDomain: None

harnesses.name: proofs::cumulative_baseline_delta_conserves_the_counter
harnesses.scalarDomain: Two arbitrary u128 values: cumulative snapshot and inherited baseline.
harnesses.containerDomain: None
requiredCoverDescriptions: cover condition: snapshot == baseline && delta == Ok(0)
cover condition: snapshot < baseline && delta == Err(Error::Underflow)

harnesses.scalarDomain: Six arbitrary u64 values accumulated in u128.
harnesses.containerDomain: Exactly six scalar buckets

harnesses.containerDomain: Exactly six wire counters

harnesses.scalarDomain: Two arbitrary u128 values and arbitrary known/unknown boolean.
harnesses.containerDomain: One inclusive output and optional reasoning subset
requiredCoverDescriptions: cover condition: known && total == 0 && reasoning == 0 && actual.is_ok()

harnesses.scalarDomain: Three arbitrary u128 values; exact sum with overflow refusal.

harnesses.scalarDomain: Five arbitrary u128 values; actual production 24-digit admission bound.
harnesses.containerDomain: Exactly five detailed buckets, six wire counters

harnesses.name: proofs::owner_merge_full_ids_rejects_distinct_known_owners
harnesses.scalarDomain: Every pair of sixteen-byte IDs and both enrichment policies. Context equality is a caller precondition.
harnesses.containerDomain: Two IDs of exactly sixteen arbitrary u8 values each
requiredCoverDescriptions: cover condition: actual.is_ok() && left == right && left != [0; 16]

harnesses.scalarDomain: Every pair of six-component u64 vectors; all equality/dominance/conflict outcomes.

harnesses.scalarDomain: Arbitrary u128 numerator and denominator; zero denominator refuses. Rounding laws are the separate production-width harness.
harnesses.containerDomain: One exact numerator/denominator pair

harnesses.scalarDomain: Five arbitrary u128 token quantities with all five rates absent.
harnesses.containerDomain: Exactly five token/rate buckets

harnesses.name: proofs::evidence_add_full_u128_keeps_zero_distinct_from_missing
harnesses.scalarDomain: Arbitrary u128 reported value, symbolic basis (reported/derived/estimated), and eight arbitrary u128 prior totals and counts. Unknown and unsupported observations are checked against the same prior.
harnesses.containerDomain: One prior EvidenceTotals and one known, one unknown and one unsupported observation
requiredCoverDescriptions: cover condition: value == 0 && actual.is_ok() && basis == Basis::Derived
cover condition: actual == Err(Error::Overflow) && basis == Basis::Estimated

harnesses.name: proofs::checked_add_full_u128_has_the_same_result_for_both_parenthesizations
harnesses.scalarDomain: Three arbitrary u128 operands; both parenthesizations return the same exact sum or overflow.
harnesses.containerDomain: Exactly three operands

harnesses.name: proofs::matching_full_population_identity_never_confuses_missing_with_zero
harnesses.scalarDomain: Two full sixteen-byte population IDs, arbitrary u16 units/grains, two arbitrary u128 values, known booleans and two symbolic bases (reported/derived/estimated).
harnesses.containerDomain: Two quantities, each carrying one sixteen-byte identity
requiredCoverDescriptions: cover condition: actual.is_ok() && left_value == 0 && left_basis != right_basis

harnesses.name: proofs::rounded_production_width_ratio_follows_floor_ceiling_and_half_up_laws
harnesses.scalarDomain: Bounded: every exact u8 quotient, nonzero denominator in one through sixty-four and remainder below it, reconstructed into the numerator so the reference needs no division; one symbolic rounding rule per execution. A u8 denominator consumed ~276 seconds of the pinned 300-second harness budget and wider operand pairs exceeded a 900-second solver budget without a counterexample (timeout is not evidence), so production-width rounding is not qualified by this harness.
harnesses.containerDomain: One exact ratio and one of the three rounding rules
requiredCoverDescriptions: cover condition: rule == Rounding::HalfUp && remainder != 0 && increment == 1
cover condition: rule == Rounding::HalfUp && remainder != 0 && increment == 0

harnesses.name: proofs::evidence_merge_full_u128_adds_every_component_or_refuses
harnesses.scalarDomain: Sixteen arbitrary u128 components (two full EvidenceTotals); every component is added exactly with overflow refusal and the merge is symmetric.
harnesses.containerDomain: Two EvidenceTotals of eight components each

harnesses.name: proofs::disjoint_output_full_u128_sums_visible_and_reasoning_once
harnesses.scalarDomain: Arbitrary u128 visible and reasoning quantities; the inclusive total is their exact sum or an overflow refusal, and the disjoint split round-trips.
harnesses.containerDomain: One disjoint visible/reasoning pair and one inclusive output

theoremReplacements.reason: Pinned Kani full-u128 division queries timed out without counterexample; required production-extracted Lean proof, three constructive witnesses, and exact half-up-offset mutation sensitivity passed before this transfer. Timeout is not evidence.
theoremReplacements.scalarDomain: Every u128 token amount in the first bucket at unit rate, with four zero token buckets and their rates absent; unchanged u128 arithmetic and 24-digit admission. No arbitrary-tariff claim.
